title: Window shell stylesheet
summary: Stylesheet for the app frame: title bar (cv-tb), menu bar, tool rail (cv-rail), document tabs (cv-tab), options row (cv-opt), status line (cv-st), jobs list, home screen (cv-home) and virtual timeline. Frame shared by formcut and formwav; reads only tokens.
description: Covers the chrome around the work area. Class families by prefix, from the file itself: `cv-vtl`, `cv-home`, `cv-tb`, `cv-hf`, `cv-st`, `cv-opt`, `cv-jobs`, `cv-rail`, `cv-tab`, `cv-dd`, `cv-selmask`, `cv-float`. The markup that uses these classes is built in `app.ts` (B06 row 6, not seeded); this slot is the stylesheet only. 24 z-index declarations all read `var(--z-*)`.
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

renameables: app-specific class prefixes cv-home and cv-hf

invariants.text: Every colour, space and radius comes from a token in the studio-dark token set (var(--bg-*), var(--text-*), var(--border-*), var(--space-*), var(--radius-*)); no literal colour values in component code.
Stacking above local ordering uses var(--z-*) from the one z scale; a raw numeric z-index is not allowed.
No scrollbar is ever drawn anywhere (the owner rule); content still scrolls by wheel, trackpad, touch and keys.
